messages:
Maya: heads-up — quick draft for internal release note. target announce window: tomorrow 10:00 PT. need audience split + rollback lanes. short copy below.

Sam: echo — we need model/runtime pin details and ops sticky pin for 48h. also confirm canary cadence.

Maya: draft snippet: "Internal: rolling out inference routing v3 — expected +15% perf, ~8% cost savings. No product changes. Rollout: canary -> staged region roll. Ops will monitor token-level cost and latency p95."

Sam: pin request: model=redwood-serve-2.4, runtime=rust-runtime-1.12. please pin config for 48h post-rollout.

DeployBot: DeployBot scheduled canary at 2026-04-02T10:00:00-07:00 (thread ts 1729812345). Canary nodes: eng-canary-1, eng-canary-2. Plan: 10% -> 30% -> 100% if no alerts for 15m between steps.

Liz: recommended rollback triggers: error rate delta > 1.5% absolute OR latency p95 increase > 50ms vs baseline OR token-cost spike > 12% over 10m window. who owns rollback execution?

Corey: I can own rollback exec. If triggered: pin back to redwood-serve-2.3, disable routing flags, and post to #incidents + page oncall.

Maya: updated internal copy: "Internal deploy: inference routing v3 (redwood-serve-2.4). No user-facing changes. Monitoring: token cost meter, p95 latency, KV cache health. If you see anomalies ping @Corey or #eng-oncall."

Sam: add alerts: model-mismatch, kv-cache-thrash, token-cost-surge, and a smoke-test failure. also include deploybot webhook to post canary progress into this thread.

DeployBot: DeployBot: canary started — spinup logs: "canary spinup OK, services green"

OpsBot: OpsBot: APM hooks hotplugged, tracing enabled. smoke tests kicked off: 2/2 smoke tests passed (latency within expected).

Liz: ok for eng-only announce? I recommend eng + cs on standby for first 2h. also request a 1-paragraph blurb for RN: "Routing v3 improves inference throughput and reduces per-token cost; no API changes. Ops controls included."

Maya: decision: eng-only notify at 09:30 PT with link to RN + runbook. escalate to cs if we observe user-facing errors. i'll send blast. final approvals?

Sam: config pinned: redwood-serve-2.4@2026-04-02-01 in infra repo. leaving sticky pin for 48h. who sends the internal message?

Maya: i'll post the internal note in #eng-releases at 09:30 PT and copy this snippet. Corey/Liz — please confirm standby.

Corey: :thumbsup: i'll be on standby 10:00–11:30 PT and will execute rollback if triggers fire. agreed on criteria.

DeployBot: DeployBot: canary healthy -> progressing to 30% (ETA 10:20 PT). posting incremental logs to thread.

Maya: thanks everyone — running the final preflight at 09:15 PT and will post RN draft for quick thumbs. :thumbsup:

Liz: noted — i'll be reachable and monitoring support queue.

DeployBot: DeployBot: 30% rollout complete, no alerts.

OpsBot: OpsBot: tracing and cost meters reporting nominal. continuing 15m window monitoring.

Sam: all set from infra side. good to proceed with blast.

Maya: sending internal announce now (eng-only). will update thread with rollout progress and any actions.

Corey: thanks — standby oncall.

Maya: final: good luck team — ping here for any anomalies.
